$comment: Worked example (issue #7): oracle judge manifest for u-tokenize-1 (Stage 2 judge-first demo; the same manifest shape ranks Stage-4 candidates). Entries resolve with the manifest's directory as cwd, which is why the two stand-in modules sit next to this file; the corpus path is resolved relative to the manifest too. Reproduce: python framework/tools/oracle.py judge --manifest framework/examples/oracle/manifests/u-tokenize-1.json (expected exit 2 — findings)

reference.$comment: real run: the live Python module, e.g. duplifind.tokenize:run

candidate.$comment: real run: the PyO3 wheel's frozen API, e.g. duplifind.tokenize:run from the installed wheel
